Andrew highlighted the importance of emphasizing sales over detailed client documentation, while team discussions explored broader deal opportunities with Zen Media and Imaginary Content, emphasizing the need for more sell-side clients. Operational improvements were proposed, including the development of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and enhanced communication strategies. The team reviewed outreach strategies for new clients and coordinated efforts to streamline LinkedIn outreach, while several action items were assigned to team members, focusing on follow-ups, proposals, and reporting tasks to strengthen client management and deal progression.
